sources.title: Sieben 2020: BubR1 allelic effects
sources.claim: Phospho-p70S6K and phospho-4EBP1 elevation in +/X753 muscle motivates a conditional pathway assay.
sources.limit: Not the selected pair; no rapalog intervention; small depicted blot groups; no randomization/blinding. Proposed pS6 is a future assay.

sources.title: Sieben corrigendum
sources.claim: Correction must remain associated with the parent study.
sources.limit: Not an independent replication or intervention experiment.

sources.title: Everolimus US prescribing information
sources.claim: Approved indications include specified pediatric TSC uses; relevant renal, infection and interaction warnings.
sources.limit: Does not establish MVA/RMS efficacy or a deficient-normal exposure window.

sources.title: Mascarenhas 2019: randomized first-relapse RMS trial
sources.claim: Temsirolimus-containing regimen favoured over bevacizumab-containing regimen for EFS.
sources.limit: Not chemotherapy-alone comparison or constitutional rescue; no significant OS difference.

sources.title: Gupta 2024: temsirolimus added to intermediate-risk RMS therapy
sources.claim: Adding temsirolimus did not demonstrate improved three-year EFS.
sources.limit: Nonsignificance is not exact-zero effect; different question from constitutional everolimus rescue.

sources.title: Yamada: rapamycin and mitotic slippage
sources.claim: Rapamycin increased slippage in the reported death-versus-slippage comparison.
sources.limit: Not all-enrolled-cell denominator, everolimus, deficient normal tissue or clinical risk estimate.

sources.title: Haas 2019: everolimus and hydroxychloroquine
sources.claim: The study met its prespecified six-month PFS threshold and reported partial responses.
sources.limit: No everolimus-only comparator; not pediatric RMS, synergy proof or deficient-normal safety.

sources.title: Tang 2011: aneuploid-cell stress vulnerabilities
sources.claim: Chloroquine-associated sensitivity supplies both mechanistic rationale and normal-cell concern.
sources.limit: Chloroquine is not HCQ; constitutional aneuploid-cell killing is not functional rescue.

sources.title: Pralatrexate in fusion-positive RMS models
sources.publication_model: Fusion-positive RMS cell and mouse models
sources.claim: Some tumours regressed; recurrence and schedule-dependent toxicity were observed.
sources.limit: No selected-pair rescue, durable cure, established clinical margin or uniquely assigned TYMS mechanism.

sources.title: Pralatrexate US label version 6
sources.claim: Approved PTCL use and folate-pathway pharmacology; marrow, mucosal and renal risks.
sources.limit: Not pediatric RMS approval; no dose or supplementation recommendation derived.

sources.title: Kurmasheva 2019: entinostat RMS preclinical testing
sources.publication_model: Two ARMS and two ERMS models
sources.claim: Mostly limited potentiation; model/endpoint-dependent vincristine antagonism reported.
sources.limit: Does not refute every future schedule; full article/corrigendum contents not exhaustively checked.

sources.title: Chauhan 2024: entinostat RMS combination models
sources.publication_model: RMS preclinical models with daily mouse regimen
sources.claim: Favourable model-dependent comparisons coexist with unadjusted testing and schedule differences.
sources.limit: Daily mouse and weekly human profiles are not equivalent despite superficially comparable single-dose AUC.

sources.title: NMPA: Entinostat Tablets Approved for Marketing
sources.claim: Approval with aromatase inhibition in a defined HR-positive HER2-negative advanced breast-cancer setting.
sources.limit: Not global unapproved status; does not establish FDA or pediatric RMS approval, availability or efficacy.

sources.title: Vorinostat anaplastic ERMS case and paired PDX
sources.publication_model: Single clinical case plus randomized PDX experiment
sources.claim: Transient clinical benefit; PDX necrosis without growth/Ki67 suppression.
sources.limit: Progression and severe thrombocytopenia/hemorrhage; uncontrolled clinical attribution and no established margin.

sources.title: TBX2/TBX3 drug repurposing screen
sources.publication_model: Inducible melanoma screen and endogenous/RMS validation
sources.claim: Niclosamide, pyrvinium and piroctone show context-dependent micromolar nominal activity.
sources.limit: Some EC50s exceed tested maxima; failed endogenous hits and reporter artefacts retained; no direct-binding or deficient-normal window.

sources.title: Schweizer 2018: niclosamide and enzalutamide
sources.claim: Tolerated original-formulation exposure fell below that study's preclinical target.
sources.limit: Not universal formulation failure or a matched free RMS exposure estimate.

sources.title: Correction: niclosamide phase I study
sources.claim: Corrected abstract range agrees with original PK table and Results.
sources.limit: Not another study or independent exposure replication.

sources.title: Parikh 2021: reformulated PDMX1001 combination
sources.claim: Favourable tolerability/response findings and scheduled total-plasma samples qualify the original-formulation negative.
sources.limit: No backbone-only control; three PK participants; one-hour sample not serially established Cmax; no RMS margin.

sources.title: Sun 2021: posaconazole in RMS models
sources.claim: Tumour-growth inhibition accompanied by liver histologic injury.
sources.limit: Not eradication; nonsignificant enzyme comparisons do not erase histology; nominal medium is not free tissue exposure.

sources.title: Posaconazole US prescribing information
sources.claim: Major interactions include serious vinca warnings and contraindicated sirolimus/selected statins.
sources.limit: Do not infer current patient regimen or convert average total plasma and binding into a validated tumour exposure.

sources.title: Xu 2013: BUBR1 recruits PP2A via B56
sources.publication_model: Engineered MVA-cell recruitment; separate HeLa chemical perturbation
sources.claim: MIS12-linked KARD recruitment improved MVA-cell chromosome alignment under MG132 arrest.
sources.limit: Not chemical rescue in those MVA cells or completed faithful daughter division.

sources.title: Leonard 2020: biased PP2A heterotrimer stabilization
sources.claim: Positive DT-061 PP2A-holoenzyme stabilization interpretation.
sources.limit: Archived independent reading abstract-only; no MVA or approved-drug bridge; mechanism disputed.

sources.title: Vit 2022: PP2A-independent cytotoxicity
sources.claim: Proposed PP2A effects not reproduced; alternative microtubule/ER-Golgi mechanisms and structural-density reassessment.
sources.limit: Does not exclude every experimental condition; not a clinical efficacy study.

sources.title: Naqvi 2026: PP2A activators and PR65 stabilization
sources.publication_model: Isolated PR65 biophysics and ensemble binding
sources.claim: ATUX-8385 binding and stabilization support a different compound/scaffold interaction.
sources.limit: Not DT-061 cellular-specificity resolution or MVA rescue; comparator spelling discrepancy remains.

sources.title: Baker 2011: genetic senescent-cell clearance
sources.claim: Favourable genetic senescent-cell-clearance evidence exists in a BubR1 model.
sources.limit: Not drug D+Q efficacy or clinical safety.

sources.title: Baker 2013: opposing p21 tissue effects
sources.claim: p21 protects muscle/fat but promotes lens senescence/cataract phenotype.
sources.limit: Lower p21 is not a universal rescue criterion; no drug therapeutic window.

sources.title: Zhu 2015: dasatinib/quercetin senolysis
sources.claim: Positive senolytic and functional findings in tested contexts.
sources.limit: Ercc1 drug intervention is not BubR1 drug rescue or pediatric safety.

sources.title: Fuhrmann-Stroissnigg 2017: HSP90 senolytics
sources.publication_model: Senescent cell types and Ercc1 mice
sources.claim: Cell-dependent senolysis and healthspan effects.
sources.limit: Not mutant-BUBR1 stabilization; reduced marker fractions may reflect population changes.

sources.title: Suijkerbuijk 2010: BUBR1 deficiency and MVA
sources.claim: Protein availability/function both matter; HSP90 inhibition can deplete unstable BUBR1.
sources.limit: Not exact-pair drug rescue; restored abundance alone is insufficient.

sources.title: Roy 2016: ataluren near-cognate tRNA selection
sources.claim: Positive context-dependent readthrough and functional-product evidence.
sources.limit: Not BUB1B efficacy or proof of native-stop toxicity; insertion need not restore wild-type residue.

sources.title: Bolze 2017: negative PTC124 and context-dependent aminoglycoside rescue
sources.claim: Ataluren negative results and sequence/species dependence; functional JAK/STAT3 assay and PTP1B controls present.
sources.limit: No universal readthrough failure or BUB1B-specific response claim.

sources.title: EMA Translarna authorization status
sources.claim: European Commission did not renew conditional authorization in March 2025.
sources.limit: Older mechanism papers cannot establish current EU approval or clinical efficacy here.

sources.title: Goutas 2023: autophagy, senescence and BUBR1
sources.publication_model: Human Wharton jelly stromal cells; early and late passage
sources.claim: Everolimus lowered late-passage BUBR1 protein at 24 h; HCQ increased it in a different exposure experiment.
sources.limit: Not the selected genotype, proof of drug-induced segregation harm, functional HCQ rescue or a clinical exposure margin.

sources.title: Quy 2013: compensatory mTORC1 after denervation
sources.claim: Rapamycin reduced protein synthesis and worsened atrophy in the tested context.
sources.limit: Denervation and rapamycin are not MVA and everolimus; selected primary sections, full XML request failed.

sources.title: Castets 2019: balanced mTORC1 and muscle adaptation
sources.publication_model: Mouse muscle denervation and Raptor/TSC perturbations
sources.claim: Pathway/flux effects depended on timing; muscle Raptor loss enhanced atrophy.
sources.limit: Not a universal inhibition hazard or the selected pair; knockout is not matched drug exposure.

sources.title: Abutaleb 2023: everolimus and HGPS tissue-engineered vessels
sources.publication_model: HGPS iPSC vascular cells and tissue-engineered vessels
sources.claim: Everolimus alone improved vasoconstriction; monotherapy did not establish improved vasodilation; combinations had context-dependent benefits and toxicity.
sources.limit: Different LMNA/progerin pathology, small model experiments and nominal concentrations; no MVA rescue or free tissue-exposure bridge.

decisions.name: Everolimus
decisions.rationale: Withdraw comparative rescue priority; retain only a model-qualified hypothesis-testing perturbation. Both maladaptive and compensatory pathway explanations remain viable.
decisions.stop_rule: No advancement from pathway suppression alone; material BUBR1 loss pauses for mechanistic review, worsened division/function or failed safety bounds stops advancement; exposure and replication must pass.

context_sources.arst1431: Tumour-claim boundary only; not direct counterevidence to constitutional rescue.
context_sources.jci_correction: Figure 2E provenance correction; does not specifically invalidate Figure 5 mTOR blots.

decisions.name: Hydroxychloroquine
decisions.rationale: Retain actual adult compound-combination signal while requiring compound-specific RMS flux/selectivity evidence. HCQ increased protein abundance at 100 micromolar for 2 h in late-passage stromal cells; this is not constitutional functional rescue or an exposure bridge.
decisions.stop_rule: Do not reopen without matched deficient-normal safety and exposure; static markers or another lysosomal drug are insufficient.

decisions.name: Pralatrexate
decisions.rationale: Optional documented fusion-positive RMS model hypothesis, not constitutional repair or assumed subject subtype.
decisions.stop_rule: No advance without subtype/comparator, matched exposure and deficient-normal safety; recurrence rules out durable-eradication claims.

decisions.name: Temsirolimus
decisions.rationale: Preserve different trial questions; prevent unsupported class-wide benefit claims.
decisions.stop_rule: No direct transfer to constitutional everolimus rescue or unqualified standard-of-care comparator.

decisions.name: Entinostat
decisions.rationale: Jurisdiction-aware eligibility does not repair model/schedule, multiplicity and exposure gaps.
decisions.stop_rule: No promotion without appropriate subtype, replicated benefit, schedule-matched exposure and deficient-normal assessment.

decisions.name: Vorinostat
decisions.rationale: Retain transient case benefit alongside progression, toxicity and negative PDX growth outcome.
decisions.stop_rule: Necrosis or target engagement alone cannot establish efficacy; require exposure and matched normal safety.

decisions.name: Niclosamide and TBX-screen compounds
decisions.rationale: Reformulation evidence tempers original PK failure but does not create a free RMS exposure bridge.
decisions.stop_rule: Verify product/jurisdiction and endogenous mechanism; no advancement from extrapolated EC50s or unmatched total-plasma comparisons.

decisions.name: Posaconazole
decisions.rationale: Actual growth inhibition retained; tissue injury and interactions undermine broad safety assumptions.
decisions.stop_rule: No advancement without justified free exposure, normal-cell function and interaction review; no paper-to-paper combination assembly.

decisions.name: PP2A recruitment and chemical tools
decisions.rationale: Exclude from approved-drug shortlist; retain localized recruitment as an optional mechanistic control.
decisions.stop_rule: Alignment under arrest, isolated scaffold binding or disputed compound annotation cannot establish faithful division or drug eligibility.

decisions.name: Drug senolysis and HSP90 inhibition
decisions.rationale: Genetic BubR1 clearance evidence and other-model drug benefits do not establish drug-mediated constitutional rescue.
decisions.stop_rule: No generic lower-p21 or marker-clearance success criterion; require tissue-resolved viable function and chromosome safety.

decisions.name: Ataluren/readthrough route
decisions.rationale: Retain mechanism-control lessons but no approved clinical candidate promotion or selected-pair functional evidence.
decisions.stop_rule: Endogenous RNA, actual traversal, full-length protein and function must pass separately; current regulatory eligibility also required.

adversarial_review.scope: All Track 2 workstreams; targeted primary rechecks, not exhaustive rescreening
adversarial_review.current_interpretation: No rescue-priority candidate; everolimus is an optional model-qualified mechanistic probe; HCQ remains reserve.
